extracted.name: Ynielle’s Potato Ham Egg Bacon Bits Salad
extracted.description: Pretty much everything in the the title:)
ingredient_lines: Basil (up to you how much basil you want to add)
instruction_lines: Boil potatoes for about 3-5 minutes. Let it cool down and then cut into cubes. Slice the ham and toast together with bacon bits. Mash the eggs.
Mix all ingredients with mayo and cream. Then let it chill for about an hour and it’s ready to serve!
